Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :GLOBAL.unit_form_checkin_flag := 'Y';
 begin
 select max(coll_date)
 into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 if :coll_date is not null
 then
 begin
 select note_id into :note_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date = :coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0190');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0160');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select note_id into :note_id
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 coll_date is null and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0160');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 :s_old_note := '';
 begin
 select note into :s_old_note
 from note_books where note_id = :note_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: INSERT_NOTE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_note is
 note_exist boolean;
 temp_note_id VARCHAR2(6);
begin
 note_exist := true;
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x from note_books
 where note_id = :ctrl_blk_1.note_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 note_exist := false;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if note_exist
 then
 begin
 update note_books
 set note = :ctrl_blk_1.s_note
 where note_id = :ctrl_blk_1.note_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
 select notebook_seq.nextval
 into :ctrl_blk_1.note_id
 from dual;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 insert into note_books
 (note_id, note)
 values (:ctrl_blk_1.note_id, :ctrl_blk_1.s_note);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update units
 set note_id = :ctrl_blk_1.note_id
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id and
 coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;
